infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Clip Station needs access to your photo library to import video and image clips for editing.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Clip Station needs permission to save exported videos to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Clip Station needs camera access to capture video clips directly.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Clip Station needs microphone access to record audio.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Clip Station to access your photos and videos to import media for video editing.
